verdict.rationale: Probes found no llms.txt (404), no markdown docs variant (404) and no OpenAPI spec at well-known paths. The only agent-consumable documentation is a downloadable zip of the full OpenAPI corpus linked from the API introduction page, which an agent could ingest after a manual download and extraction step. The Zoho MCP offering supports agent integration but is a tool connection, not agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: an llms.txt file, markdown or plain-text agent-readable doc pages, a directly fetchable OpenAPI URL, and documentation written specifically for agents.
